decision_triggers: If line_loss_events is 0 on the oval, S-bend and slalom but max_error still approaches 0.06 m, set wheel_track to 0.12 m next iteration.
If line_loss_events stays at 1 or more on the S-bend or slalom with this geometry, the cause is not geometric. Keep geometry fixed and report where on the course the loss begins.
If runs complete and completion_time exceeds 2.5 s, test wheel_radius 0.035 m next iteration.
integration_questions: Does kp 2.2 with kd 0.3 reduce max_error on the S-bend and slalom compared with iteration 8?
At what course position do any remaining S-bend or slalom line losses begin, and what is the steering signal at that point?
Did any oval seed finish, and if so, what limited the time or the progress?

intent: Hold the iteration 5, 7 and 8 geometry exactly, so the Integrator's kp 2.2 and kd 0.3 controller change is the only variable. Expected result: the S-bend and slalom line-loss events fall toward 0 and max_error drops below 0.06 m, or the score stays near 88 on the oval-driven mean. If line_loss_events is 0 on all three tracks while max_error still nears 0.06 m, the next geometry step is wheel_track 0.12 m. Geometry is not changed this iteration because the trigger is not met.
learning: Iterations 3 to 8 show that the plus or minus 0.05 m span removes oval line loss, mass has negligible effect, and controller-side changes have now reduced S-bend and slalom loss from 1.0 to about 0.05. Record whether kp 2.2 and kd 0.3 continue that trend. If max_error stays near 0.061 m with no loss on any track, the wheel_track 0.12 m lever is the next test. Revise H4 and H5 from the race, not from this proposal.
rationale: Iteration 8 raced the iteration 5 and 7 geometry unchanged (seven 16 mm sensors at x = -0.05 to +0.05 m, y = 0.04 m, mass 0.6 kg, wheel_track 0.10 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m, body 0.18 x 0.12 m) with the Integrator's controller change. It scored 88.24, the best so far. The gain comes mainly from the oval, where one seed reached a high score, but the oval mean still ends off_track with progress 0.33. S-bend and slalom now log about 0.05 line-loss events each, down from 1.0, so the controller side is the likely source of the improvement. Max_error on all tracks is still 0.061 to 0.062 m, just above the fixed 0.06 m off-track limit. The Integrator's rule to widen wheel_track to 0.12 m applies only when line_loss_events is 0 on all three tracks. The S-bend and slalom still show 0.05 events, so that trigger is not met. The wheel_radius trigger also does not apply, since no run finishes. Body_width still cannot move the 0.06 m limit, and mass has shown no measurable effect. I therefore hold the geometry exactly as in iterations 5, 7 and 8. The race is meant to isolate the Integrator's kp 2.2 and kd 0.3 change. Hypothesis H4: the remaining off-track events come from controller overshoot at bend onset, not from sensor coverage, because the outer sensors already see tape to about 0.07 m offset. Hypothesis H5: if line-loss events on the S-bend and slalom fall to 0, the next lever is wheel_track 0.12 m, since max_error is still about 0.061 m.
